sentences.text: That’s the end of the course, so here are my last five tips for exam day.
Read every question twice, and note what it asks for: true, magnetic or compass.
If the question gives you a variation, use that one, not the chart’s rose.
Show your work, every step, so you can find a mistake.
If your answer is off by exactly one hundred eighty degrees, you read the wrong side of the rose, or you reversed a set.
And use the plotting drills in this app every day, until the arithmetic is automatic.
You began this course leaving the dock in Tampa Bay, not knowing where the rules changed.
Now you know the rules, the lights, the buoys, the tides, the weather, how to keep your passengers safe, and how to find your way home with a pencil.
